decisions.summary: Amendment 1: D5 withdrawn - the ring index for AccessTree.targets, exact but 1-4% slower than the scan at 40 households on all four seeds (8 of 8 alternated pairs, research R10); the scan restored with the attempt recorded at targets; FR-004's index not shipped; the miss raised with the GM
decisions.why: FR-004 is not met, so this narrows the spec. It passes the third test: applying FR-004 literally would defeat the request's own stated purpose, concretely. The GM's question was 'improve the performance of our scripted hamlet generation ... make sure there's no more low hanging fruit', and the lever the GM accepted was proposed as 'index targets ... (output-identical, the safest lever)' - an index offered solely as a speed lever. Shipping it makes every 40-household roll measured slower and the code more complex, i.e. the opposite of the one thing the request asks for; the request carries no purpose (map change, structure, style) that a slower index would still serve. This is not cost-avoidance or completing the GM's thought: the index was built, proven exact (R7), and withdrawn on a wall-clock measurement taken base and clone back to back as FR-007 requires. The spec already contemplates it (FR-007 'including any lever withdrawn'; SC-002/SC-003 misses recorded and raised, not pursued). One item, one class: only targets is withdrawn; FR-005's index (D6) ships. Condition: the GM is told FR-004 was not shipped and why, in the same raise as SC-002/SC-003 (the plan commits to this; CLAUDE.md requires it).

decisions.summary: Amendment 1: P3's three forms withdrawn under D10 (summed homesteads at 40: A 113.7, A' 198.6, B 82.7 against P2 77.0 s; research R10); T32-T34 dropped
decisions.why: D10 applied as approved in round 1, by the rule fixed before measuring. Checked separately per form: A and A' are slower on the sum and on most seeds. B is faster on three seeds (4, 39, 47) but 2.3x slower on seed 25 (17.90 vs 7.79 s), which loses the sum. That counts as slower: a form that more than doubles one of the fixed reference seeds is the village-size tail the scaling leg exists to catch, and the spec keeps slow seeds in the set on purpose (Edge Cases). Withdrawing B serves the purpose; keeping it would trade a mean gain for a tail. Raise B's split result with the GM, since it is the closest miss.

decisions.summary: Amendment 1: two pre-existing cohort failures fixed (Audit-905 field spur tip, Audit-11 row street run short of the brook; research R8, R9); cohort 28/30 -> 30/30; Kashikawa regenerated with one more lane
decisions.why: Not a narrowing: it adds nothing the request excludes and removes nothing it asked for. Constitution XIV and the GM's standing ruling (2026-10-01, 'We should definitely fix the pre-existing failure') require it; FR-008 lets maps move within the rules. The map moved by regeneration, not by hand.
